content.text:
The discussion’s diagnosis is correct. Two separate failures compounded:

1. **Immediate CI failure:** hk pinned `jdx/packslip@v1.0.1` to a SHA, but that composite action internally used `actions/attest-build-provenance@v2` without a full SHA. hk’s GitHub Actions policy rejected that nested action while preparing `create-release`. The [release run](https://github.com/jdx/hk/actions/runs/33982465558) shows every build succeeding, then `create-release` failing at “Set up job”—before any release step executed.

2. **Release bookkeeping failure:** the `v1.58.0` tag and changelog entry already existed before publishing began. Because `create-release` never ran:

   - no GitHub release or draft was created;
   - `cargo publish` was skipped;
   - release-note enhancement and final publication were skipped.

The dependency was corrected in [PR #1335](https://github.com/jdx/hk/pull/1335): packslip `v1.1.1` pins the nested provenance action to a full SHA. Then `v1.58.1` released successfully.

The remaining missing-notes problem happened because release generation treats **the previous Git tag**, not the previous successfully published release, as its boundary. Therefore `v1.58.1` compared `v1.58.0...v1.58.1`; it had no reason to include the changes already assigned to the dead `v1.58.0` tag.

Why pre-release checks missed it: hk’s workflow visibly pinned packslip correctly, and the nested violation lived inside the external composite action. The repository’s policy only exposed it when GitHub expanded that action during the real release job.

const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: .codex-v1.58.0-release-notes.md
+> [!IMPORTANT]
+> The original `v1.58.0` publishing workflow failed after the tag was created. This backfilled release contains no binary assets and was not published to crates.io. The changes below first became available to installers in `v1.58.1`; use that version or newer.
+
+This release adds the droast Dockerfile linter and fixes several places where hk's effective behavior diverged from its configuration: project and global Pkl scalar settings now reach the runtime, standalone subdirectory configs stay scoped to their own project, and `HK_CHECK` plus the corresponding git settings correctly select check or fix commands. Release binaries also regain their embedded Pkl package instead of silently falling back to the network.
+
+## Added
+
+- **droast Dockerfile linter** ([@illesnagy1](https://github.com/illesnagy1)) [#1302](https://github.com/jdx/hk/pull/1302). The new `droast` builtin checks `Dockerfile`, `Dockerfile.*`, and `Containerfile*` files and can apply droast's safe, deterministic fixes with `hk fix`.
+
+## Fixed
+
+- **Pkl scalar settings now take effect** ([@jdx](https://github.com/jdx)) [#1307](https://github.com/jdx/hk/pull/1307). `terminal_progress`, `walk_ignore`, and `stash_backup_count` are now loaded from project Pkl and user-global configuration, merged with the existing project-first precedence, and shown correctly by `hk config dump`.
+- **Standalone subprojects stay in scope** ([@thespags](https://github.com/thespags)) [#1290](https://github.com/jdx/hk/pull/1290). Running hk from a subdirectory with its own `hk.pkl` no longer causes that config to match unrelated files from the repository root. Literal `dir = "."` steps are scoped correctly as well.
+- **Check/fix settings select the right command** ([@jdx](https://github.com/jdx)) [#1318](https://github.com/jdx/hk/pull/1318). `HK_CHECK`, `git config hk.check`, and `git config hk.fix` now affect run-type selection as documented. Explicit flags retain highest precedence, and check mode wins when configuration is contradictory so hk leaves files unchanged.
+- **pinact sees root action metadata** ([@risu729](https://github.com/risu729)) [#1321](https://github.com/jdx/hk/pull/1321). The `pinact` and `pinact_update` builtins now include a repository-root `action.yml` or `action.yaml`, not only workflow and nested action files.
+- **Release binaries embed the Pkl package again** ([@sahidvelji](https://github.com/sahidvelji)) [#1299](https://github.com/jdx/hk/pull/1299). Release builds now generate the gitignored builtin package before compilation and fail if it is absent, preventing a supposedly self-contained binary from silently requiring a network fetch.
+- **Release publication targets the source repository** ([@jdx](https://github.com/jdx)) [#1292](https://github.com/jdx/hk/pull/1292), avoiding accidental reliance on the caller's current repository context.
+
+## Documentation
+
+- Corrected configuration precedence, check/fix environment-variable behavior, supported skip reasons, stash descriptions, and several CLI examples; added missing help for hook subcommands and options [#1316](https://github.com/jdx/hk/pull/1316).
+- Clarified that Lefthook provides partial pre-commit stash handling while leaving untracked files visible [#1297](https://github.com/jdx/hk/pull/1297).
+- Added Open Graph and search metadata, including the initial social preview image [#1324](https://github.com/jdx/hk/pull/1324) [#1327](https://github.com/jdx/hk/pull/1327).
+
+## Release and CI
+
+Release and performance infrastructure was updated throughout this cycle: hk adopted the mr-boxington cargo shim and dedicated performance runners, restored and refined remote build caching, updated runner images and action dependencies, added conventional-commit enforcement, and introduced signed packslip generation for release artifacts.
+
+## New Contributors
+
+- [@thespags](https://github.com/thespags) made their first contribution in [#1290](https://github.com/jdx/hk/pull/1290).
+- [@illesnagy1](https://github.com/illesnagy1) made their first contribution in [#1302](https://github.com/jdx/hk/pull/1302).
+
+**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jdx/hk/compare/v1.57.0...v1.58.0
+
+## 💚 Sponsor hk
+
+hk is maintained by [@jdx](https://github.com/jdx), an open source developer at [**entire.io**](https://entire.io/), the title sponsor of his open source work.
+
+If hk speeds up your pre-commit loop or makes linting less painful, please consider becoming an [individual or company sponsor](https://jdx.dev/sponsors.html). Your support funds ongoing development and helps keep hk fast, free, and independent.
*** End Patch";
